title: Billing Operations Note: How the Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Appears on Receipts, Statements and the Agreement Ledger
content:
Every Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan has a fixed presentation: how the prepayment receipt reaches the tenant, how often a plan statement is sent and under what short name, how savings are shown, the day each prepaid month is applied, how that application reads on the covered agreement's ledger, and how plan amounts are rounded.

| Plan | Short name on statements | Plan statement sent | Prepayment receipt delivered by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Prepay 3 | At the end of the term | Email |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Prepay 6 | Quarterly | Email |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Prepay 9 | Quarterly | Email |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Prepay 12 | Quarterly | Email |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | Prepay 18 | Quarterly | Email |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | Prepay 24 | Quarterly | Email |

Common to all six plans:

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| Day each prepaid month is applied | Each due date of the covered agreement |
| How an application appears on the agreement ledger | As a payment by the method "prepaid rent plan" |
| How savings are shown to the tenant | Dollars saved compared with paying monthly |
| Rounding of plan amounts | To the cent, half up |

## Notes

- **Statement timing.** The 3-month plan is the only plan whose statement is sent once, at the end of the term; the other five send a statement every quarter.
- **Rounding, both sides (hypothetical amounts).** An amount of $412.345 rounds to $412.35 (the half cent rounds up); $412.344 rounds to $412.34.
- **Ledger reading.** On the covered agreement's ledger, each prepaid month shows as a payment on that due date by the method "prepaid rent plan", so the agreement's rent for the period is shown as paid by the plan.
